name: a fresh group on the page: Did Mount, Children Count 4 (its buttons), Child Index 0, This itself — no Value, no Changed
because: react-component-node.ts :982-990 (Did Mount), :1599-1620 (each addChild schedules the count), :1428-1444; radiobuttongroup.ts sends Value only on a write

name: Value from the graph: sent, never Changed; the same value again: nothing; another: sent
because: radiobuttongroup.ts :84-99 — a change sends Value and nothing else (the description: a value arriving on Value does not fire Changed)

name: Value that is not text: a number, a boolean, a list and an object are converted by their toString; null and undefined are ignored (a text write beside them is sent)
because: radiobuttongroup.ts :89-90 — `value?.toString !== undefined` then `typeof value !== 'string'` returns

name: a pick on a fresh group: Value and Changed; the same button again: nothing (it is selected); another: Value and Changed
because: RadioButton.tsx :187-189 → RadioButtonGroup.tsx :27-30 → radiobuttongroup.ts :20-29; a click on a selected radio raises no change

name: the button with no Value is the selected one while the group's Value was never written: picking it raises nothing; once a Value is written it can be picked, and the Value goes back to nothing
because: RadioButton.tsx :58 `selected === props.value` — undefined === undefined; radiobuttongroup.ts :21 `_internal.value !== value`

name: a strict compare: Value "1" does not select the button whose Value is the number 1 — picking it sends the number and fires Changed; the number written back is converted to "1": sent, no Changed
because: RadioButton.tsx :58 `===`; radiobuttongroup.ts :89 converts the number, :92 `value !== this._internal.value`

name: a pick of a Value no button on the page carries: nothing to click (a pick of one that is there, beside it, fires)
because: the group's page holds its four buttons (THE FIRST VISUAL WITH CHILDREN); a person clicks what is on the page

name: Value written then the same button picked in one frame: the page paints first, so the button is already selected — nothing from the pick; the other button in the same frame fires
because: adapter.ts `act`: an act happens on a painted page; RadioButtonGroup.tsx :37-39 the effect sets the selection at the paint

name: row C76 — a pick, then Value written back to the old value in the same frame: the Value goes back, but the picked button stays selected (the frame end's render brings no new Value to the effect), so picking it again raises nothing
because: radiobuttongroup.ts :20-29 then :84-99 in one frame; RadioButtonGroup.tsx :37-39 the effect keys on the Value the last paint rendered — the pick's own re-render reused that paint's props (react-component-node.ts :1076-1103); NSP-016 §7.7 C76

name: row C76, the other half — after the write-back, picking the button the Value names selects it and fires nothing (the node already holds that Value); the next pick fires again
because: RadioButtonGroup.tsx :27-30 selects it, radiobuttongroup.ts :21 `_internal.value !== value` is false; NSP-016 §7.7 C76

name: Mounted off: Will Unmount, and a pick reaches no button; on: Did Mount, and the pick fires
because: react-component-node.ts :2302-2321; the buttons are rendered inside the group, so off the page there is nothing to click

name: Mounted off and a pick in the same frame: the paint takes the group off first — Will Unmount, nothing picked
because: adapter.ts `act`: the page follows first

name: placed off the page: no Did Mount, but Children Count is sent — the buttons are its children either way; a pick reaches nothing; Mounted on: Did Mount
because: react-component-node.ts :1611-1620 `addChild` is not a render; :2302-2321

name: placed with a Value: sent in the first frame; picking that button raises nothing, another fires
because: the params are set before the first render: useState starts from the Value (RadioButtonGroup.tsx :21)

name: a pick before the first frame: the act paints the page (Did Mount) and picks — Value, Changed, Children Count all in frame 1
because: adapter.ts `act`; react-component-node.ts :982-990

name: a remount keeps the Value: the selection starts from it again, so the picked button is still selected
because: RadioButtonGroup.tsx :21 `useState({ value: props.value })` at the new mount

name: Scroll Into View and the look ports: nothing on the wire (a Value write beside them is sent)
because: react-component-node.ts :1380-1395; the look and layout ports are stored and read by no output (R10)

name: the pick's own paint: Mounted off, a pick, Mounted on in one frame — Will Unmount at the pick, Did Mount at the frame's end; and from off, on, a pick, off — Did Mount, then Will Unmount
because: adapter.ts `act`: the page follows at the act; only a Mounted write AFTER the act in the same frame tells the act's paint from the frame end's (the Icon's, NSP-016 §7.6)

name: the pick's own paint, nothing picked: placed off, Mounted on, a pick of no button, Mounted off in one frame — Did Mount at the pick, Will Unmount at the frame's end
because: adapter.ts `act`: the page follows at the act even when the act itself does nothing (the deep run at 10,000 reached this branch; 200 sequences did not)

name: Margin Top wired null: the interpreter stores it and nothing moves on the wire — the runtime's generated setter reads `.value` of null and throws
because: react-component-node.ts the `inputCss` units setter (`typeof value !== 'object'` lets null through, then `value.value`); every node with margins — NSP-016 §7.2 row C62

name: Pos X wired undefined: the interpreter stores it and nothing moves on the wire — the runtime's setter reads `.value` of undefined and throws
because: node-shared-port-definitions.ts the Placement setters read `value.value`; every node with Placement inputs — NSP-016 §7.2 row C63
